description: Stock splits a company's record has adjusted for: every split applied (ratio and date), which figures were restated for it, and any as-reported pre-split values the record keeps alongside. Per-share figures and share counts Ticker Scout publishes are split-adjusted, so periods before and after a split compare directly. Also returns the record's notes that mention a split.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_stock_splits
title: Stock splits and share adjustments
